opening.argument: The description presents Forsage as an earning platform operating across more than 200 countries, while the speaker ties participation directly to registration through Trust Wallet: “I'm Working On The Forsage.io International Project The Forsage.io Registration in The Trust Wallet App”. The demonstrated process requires installing the wallet, creating an account, and recording its 12-word phrase, including by photographing it, before entering those words for verification. The screen warns against sharing the phrase, but the material does not show the speaker requesting disclosure, requiring a payment or transfer, or establishing that anyone earned money or suffered a loss. Those limits do not remove the central link between broad earning claims and a low-barrier wallet-based registration procedure.
